reden: Yes. The audit report explicitly flags that PhiFactory.signatureClaim decodes the chainId from the signed payload but never validates it against block.chainid, allowing cross-chain replay when calling signatureClaim directly. It describes the same function, mechanism (ignored chainId in signature verification), and attack path (reuse a signature from one chain on another). Applying the suggested fix (validate/substitute chainId) would resolve both issues, so they are the same vulnerability.
